title: Vintage Nomar Cast Iron Poêlon – Rare Floral Folk Pattern Staub Group – 1970s
description:
Rare vintage Nomar France enamelled cast iron poêlon with beautiful floral folk pattern in warm mustard, brown and cream tones. A stunning retro French kitchen piece inspired by the iconic countryside cookware designs of the 1970s.
This charming cast iron poêlon comes with its original matching lid and features a unique scalloped inner detail under the lid, adding to its decorative and collectible appeal. Heavy quality piece made in France, perfect for cooking, serving or displaying in a vintage kitchen collection.
Approximate dimensions: around 20 cm diameter and approximately 10 cm height without lid. Very good vintage condition with light signs of age and use consistent with vintage enamelled cast iron cookware.
A rare and authentic French vintage piece for collectors of Nomar, retro enamel cookware and rustic farmhouse decor.
